It says that each generator `relation K ι i j` lies in the library's own ideal `ideal K ι`, which is defined as the span of those relations. The proof is just `Ideal.subset_span` applied to that definition. `Ideal.subset_span` is a generic fact: every set is contained in the ideal it spans. It does not carry the theorem's content. That content lies entirely in the library's own definitions of `relation` and `ideal`, which are specific to the coordinate ring of upper-triangular matrices. So nothing in Mathlib states this result. I did not run a separate search of Mathlib.
